thesis: Namit is a product engineer in New York who designs and ships AI agents, and every number here links to where it came from.

fills.text: CURRENTLY: Co-founder of ChekOut AI, designing and building the shopping agent live on 8 merchants' stores.

fills.alt: ChekOut AI's agent open on a laptop beside a merchant's storefront
fills.caption: ChekOut AI: Shoppers had questions a product grid can't answer. My agent answers from the store's catalog, and 20% of Kivakube's add-to-carts came through it.
fills.explain: ChekOut's shopping agent open beside a merchant's storefront. I designed and built the shopper conversation, the product cards, the motion and the merchant dashboard, and the builder merchants use to brand it. Ask how it works or what it changed to see the evidence.

fills.alt: Christine Valmy's enrollment agent beside the inquiry form
fills.caption: Christine Valmy: Students waited on a form while officers repeated themselves. A bilingual agent took visitor conversion from 10% to 23%.
fills.explain: The enrollment agent beside the school's inquiry form. User testing killed my first design; the bilingual agent that shipped answers students in English or Spanish and sorts every lead for the officers. Ask how testing changed it to see the before and after.

fills.alt: KYURI.OS Job Hunt page with live pipeline totals
